summary_en: Shimizu Corporation announced a buyback framework increasing the acquisition limit to 10 billion yen from 10 billion yen, with 4.25 million shares planned for purchase via ToSTNeT-3 on September 25, 2026, alongside the issuance of convertible bonds to finance M&A and share repurchases.
title_en: Supplementary Explanation Material on the Issuance of Euro Yen-Denominated Convertible Bonds and Share Buyback
translation_en_brief:
On September 24, 2026, Shimizu Corporation announced an expansion of its share buyback framework and the issuance of convertible bonds totaling 1 trillion yen. The company increased its share repurchase authorization limit from 10 billion yen to 20 billion yen for the period from August 17 to December 30, 2026.

The company plans to acquire 4.25 million shares totaling 10 billion yen through ToSTNeT-3 on September 25, 2026, the day following board approval. The buyback is funded by proceeds from the issuance of two tranches of euro yen-denominated convertible bonds: 50 billion yen of 5-year bonds maturing in 2031 and 50 billion yen of 7-year bonds maturing in 2033, both issued at 103% of face value with 0% coupons.

Of the total 100 billion yen in bond proceeds, approximately 90 billion yen is allocated to finance acquisitions, primarily the acquisition of American Engineering Corporation (Okinawa) to make it a wholly-owned subsidiary. The remaining 10 billion yen supports the share buyback. Both bond tranches include conversion restrictions and cash settlement call provisions tied to the bonds' maturity dates.
